No folders selected. Choose Library folders to start loading media.

Background playback is enabled by default for video and audio. This app needs notifications to continue playing with the screen off and to provide lock-screen pause and resume controls. If notifications are denied, background playback stops. You can enable notifications later from the button on the library screen.
Screen-off playback is blocked: enable notifications in Settings
Create or open a playlist → Add files → Play. Playlists are saved automatically.
